newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian/U.S. bond spreads little changed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian/U.S. bond spreads little changed.

text.p: Odd-lot buying interest of futures helped Australian bonds finally catch up with a firm U.S. Treasury market during the afternoon, but local turnover remained extremely thin.
Spread differentials to the U.S. had widened in the early part of the day after Friday's U.S. rally which followed a weak durable goods orders report and a surge in the U.S. dollar against the yen.
The firm U.S. Treasuries tone continued in a shortened Tokyo session, closing early ahead of this week's Japanese New Year holidays.
Canadian bonds strengthened during their shortened session on Friday, spurred on by the U.S., while New Zealand yields drifted lower today in minimal trade.
